title: 7 Days To Blood Moon
description: A Blood Moon appears every seventh night.
body:
# 7 Days To Blood Moon
**A Blood Moon appears every seventh night; during the Blood Moon, various horde events will take place—for example, hordes of zombies or Husks.**

![the Blood Moon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36d25c69a98773219acb75a8786cd71f8f51bbe1_0.webp)
**The Blood Moon was reworked starting with version 1.0.1 and now looks different than in version 1.0.0.**

![Zombie Animals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5e4e9f2a3d187f17f806b521e0e99dba5b1941b.png)
The mod adds zombie animals; a variety of them are included, ranging from zombie pigs to zombie wolves.

![Horde Events](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/39bb3d76efeb4214ef803bbc19801b011480cd8a_0.webp)
**During a Blood Moon, horde events can occur; these range from standard zombie hordes to hordes of zombie animals.**
